galaxy_setting.name: ShipLineUpgrades_AIPUpgradeCost
galaxy_setting.description: The amount of AIP inflicted upon a player when upgrading one of their ship lines. Upgrades always cost Command Frequency Bandwidth and either AIP, Science or Hacking points.

galaxy_setting.name: ShipLineUpgrades_ScienceUpgradeCost
galaxy_setting.description: The cost of Science Points for a player when upgrading one of their ship lines. Upgrades always cost Command Frequency Bandwidth and either AIP, Science or Hacking points.

galaxy_setting.name: ShipLineUpgrades_HackingUpgradeCost
galaxy_setting.description: The cost of Hacking Points for a player when upgrading one of their ship lines. Upgrades always cost Command Frequency Bandwidth and either AIP, Science or Hacking points.

galaxy_setting.name: ShipLineUpgrades_BaseFrequencyUpgradeCost
galaxy_setting.description: The base cost of Command Frequency Bandwidth for a player when upgrading one of their ship lines. This slightly balances out upgraded caps being rounded down and having less cap than theoretically yielded.

galaxy_setting.name: ShipLineUpgrades_BaseFrequencyDowngradeYield
galaxy_setting.description: The base yield of Command Frequency Bandwidth for a player when downgrading one of their ship lines. This slightly balances out downgraded caps being rounded up and having more cap than theoretically yielded.
